title: Implement policy-gated provider-neutral executor dispatch
businessObjective: Dispatch approved bounded work to the correct provider-neutral executor without granting the provider workflow, policy, authorization, or audit authority.
technicalObjective: Implement policy-gated selection and dispatch to registered ExecutorAdapter implementations, including the separate Codex repository adapter and specialized deterministic GitHub, Cloudflare, CMS, notification, and approved-service adapters.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
The P4-007 Codex repository adapter uses the supervised Mac Mini worker and P4-005 provider transport; deterministic executors are preferred when reasoning is unnecessary.
acceptanceCriteria: ExecutorAdapter selection is provider-neutral, capability-based, and occurs only after deterministic policy and approval evaluation.
Codex repository work is delegated only through the separately verified P4-007 ExecutorAdapter and its bounded task envelope.
GitHub, Cloudflare, CMS, notification, and approved-service operations use bounded deterministic adapters when AI reasoning is unnecessary.
No executor can expand capabilities, authorize its own proposal, bypass a kill switch, or become the audit source of truth.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the executor-dispatch branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
